penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: QA review and code remediation of AI-generated apps is inherently per-customer manual work — each app is different and requires human (or heavy Claude) judgment to assess and fix. Even with Claude doing heavy lifting, the operator must review outputs before delivery.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: SMB owners using Lovable will expect at minimum a scoping call or async back-and-forth to understand their app's intent before any remediation can begin. Discovery is essentially a sales/consulting step.

rationale: The buyer (SMB owner who paid for Lovable and got a broken app) is real and has already shown willingness to spend money, but this is fundamentally a freelance dev service dressed up as a product. Every engagement requires custom per-customer review of their unique AI-generated codebase — there is no repeatable, automatable delivery loop here. Operational autonomy scores very low (3) because each job needs human judgment, and that penalty stack (-2.5) drags the total below the validate threshold. This is a consulting gig, not a factory-compatible micro-service.
solution_plan: Not recommended for this factory. A solo non-technical operator could not realistically build, sell, and maintain a code-QA-and-remediation service hands-off: each client's Lovable-generated app is unique, diagnosis requires reading code, and fixes require writing or approving code changes. Claude could assist with automated linting or pattern-matching reports, but the core value delivery (telling the client 'here is what's broken and here is the fix') requires per-customer human judgment that cannot be productised without significant tooling investment. If pursued, it would operate as a freelance consulting service — outside the scope of this factory.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy gate (3 < 7) and buildability_with_ai gate (5 < 6). Combined penalties of -2.5 for per-customer manual fulfillment and synchronous human involvement drop total to 2.3. Drop.
